project.name: Terrace
project.identity: A spec-driven workflow CLI for AI-assisted development with explicit context, planning, execution, and release gates.
project.audience: Developers and agent operators who need repeatable, inspectable workflows across repositories.
project.core_loop: Describe a task, route it through project and agent context, inspect the plan and evidence, execute bounded work, verify the result, and apply release checks.
project.north_star: An AI-assisted development task is understandable, repeatable, and auditable from request through verified release readiness.
not_this: An autonomous publisher that bypasses gates
A workflow that silently overwrites project truth

mvp.definition: The CLI can initialize a repository and drive a documented task through context, planning, bounded execution, and release checks with inspectable artifacts.

complete_product.definition: Terrace provides a stable, cross-repository workflow contract with reliable context selection, execution evidence, recovery, and release gates for the supported developer and agent workflows.

outcomes.name: A task has an explicit workflow and its execution produces evidence that can be reviewed before completion.

layers.intended: The operator should know what Terrace will do and why before effects occur.
layers.planned: Planning documents define the CLI, agent contracts, and staged v0.2 workflow surface.
layers.implemented: The repository contains init, agent, planning, and release-gate commands.
layers.verified: The documented command surface is evidence of implementation; cross-repository release behavior was not executed here.

evidence.note: Documents Terrace's purpose and command surface.
Defines the project direction and workflow constraints.

blockers.summary: Stable cross-repository behavior and release-gate coverage remain to be proven beyond repository documentation.

outcomes.name: A workflow can stop on missing evidence or failed checks and make the exact next safe action visible.

layers.intended: Users retain control over effects and can recover from incomplete workflow state.
layers.planned: Roadmap and state documents keep release gates and staged delivery explicit.
layers.implemented: Gate and release-related surfaces are present in the CLI.
layers.verified: No hosted or full release validation was run during this bootstrap.

evidence.note: Records staged product state and remaining delivery work.

blockers.summary: The staged v0.2 surface still needs its full supported workflow and recovery matrix verified.

implemented.note: Documented commands and current package surface.

verified.note: Repository-recorded state; no fresh command execution here.

drift.summary: The documented workflow intent is broader than the staged package surface and is not fully verified across repositories.

evidence.note: Records staged delivery and remaining work.
